aboutAuthor: William O'Neil with Matthew Galgani and Amy Smith compiled the trilogy — Complete System, Success Stories, and Getting Started — to make CAN SLIM teachable, verifiable, and practicable for individual investors.

points.heading: System, stories, practice pyramid
points.body: Book one codes CAN SLIM gates, book two proves teachability via verified stories, book three drills 15-minute daily routine. Each layer fixes weakness of reading alone.

points.heading: CAN SLIM gates every idea
points.body: C acceleration, A annual 25 percent, N newness, S volume demand, L leader RS, I sponsors, M market — one failure vetoes despite strength elsewhere, preventing averaging over quality.

points.heading: Chart plus volume timing
points.body: Cup-handle fifteen to thirty depth, handle five to fifteen down on low volume, breakout 1.5 times average in stage one or two, with RS line leading, times fundamentals.

points.heading: Sell at eight, hold power eight weeks
points.body: Mechanical seven to eight percent stop prevents fifty percent wipe; power stocks up twenty in three weeks held eight weeks let winners reach forty and make 35 percent win rate positive.

points.heading: Concentrate six to eight in theme leaders
points.body: Rotate with 197 groups heat map to fish where tailwind lifts leaders; diversifying into laggards for feel dilutes and underperforms.

points.heading: Verify before capital
points.body: Bonus eight-chart quiz and paper trade three months before real money prove readiness; verified equity curves show process adherence, not prediction, compounds.

insights: AAII 1998-2009 study where CAN SLIM at 2,763 percent versus S&P 500 at 3.3 percent annually via 50-strategy comparison.
Pharmacist teacher who turned Rs 5 lakh to Rs 25 lakh in three years by holding leaders in uptrend and cash in correction.
Bonus quiz where eight weekly charts test breakout calls where volume and stage decide sixty percent correctly.
conclusion: The trilogy makes CAN SLIM complete by layering system, verified stories, and daily practice so individual investors can screen, time, and hold leaders with disciplined selling that turns a 35 percent win rate into compounding outperformance.
